follows: VR 3-point dev sanity on seeds 1000-1004 (not reused): touch 4/5, grasp 2/5, place 2/5, no falls. Runner fix: zmq_manager starts control from the streamer start command, so the streamer must be running before the deploy.
hypothesis: Feeding wrist poses through SONIC VR 3-point mode avoids the lossy wrist/elbow joint tracking, so the hand follows the plan and place rate is higher than the frozen hybrid.
seeds: 1100-1139 (40 new seeds), 1 rollout each, same seeds for both conditions

conditions.vr3: run_trials_vr3.py on plans/cl_seed{seed}.npz (stance 0), compliance default 0.05, no other tuning
conditions.hybrid_frozen: the frozen v4 hybrid, unchanged: stream_cl.py --mode rr --kr 1 --lim 0.6 --w-rot 0.05 --tail-traj plans/ol_seed{seed}.npz --tail-from lift --blend-s 1.0

decision_rule: VR3 is called better than the hybrid only if place_vr3 - place_hybrid >= 5 of 40 AND paired McNemar exact p < 0.05. Otherwise it is reported as not shown better (comparable or worse). Pooled earlier hybrid result (27/80 = 34%) is context, not the comparison.
